newsitem.title: ITALY: Finmeccanica buys Breda for 38.2 bln lire.
newsitem.headline: Finmeccanica buys Breda for 38.2 bln lire.

text.p: Italian state-controlled industrial group Finmeccanica said it has acquired for 38.2 billion lire ($23.7 million) railway equipment company Breda Costruzioni Ferroviare and other rail units of state holding Efim which is in liquidation.
Finmeccanica said in a statement it is also taking on financial debts for around 180 billion lire.
The purchase follows a deal concluded in July 1996 with Efim's liquidators which handed over management of Breda and the other rail units to Finmeccanica.
The sale had been dependent on several conditions including that of getting the go-ahead from the European Community and Italy's Antitrust authority.
Breda group companies had revenues of around 700 billion lire in 1996 and a workforce of 3,400.
The plan presented to the EU Commission forecasts 1997 revenues of 800 billion lire and profit breakeven.
